releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.38:
- Restored High-Definition Thermal Receipt Logo: Restored the proven Ticket #10003 high-contrast binary logo with bold silhouettes, deep black lines, and clear typography.
- Intelligent Can vs Bottle Barcode Scanner: Scanning a Can product directly opens the Can option and Can Bucket option; scanning a Bottle product directly opens the Bottle option and Bottle Bucket option, ensuring exact inventory distinction between cans and bottles.
- Dedicated CUBETAS / BUCKETS Hub: Prominent amber BUCKETS card in the BEER department featuring 3 dedicated tabs: Domestic Buckets, Imported Buckets, and Mix & Match (5 Pieces).
- Clean Mix & Match Architecture: Removed redundant mix-match buttons from single beer popups and loose product grids, consolidating all custom bucket building into the CUBETAS hub.
- 100% Quality Standard: Passed all pre-flight simulator checks and integrity audits with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
